sentences.text: Cooper is on day 46 of 56 of a hydrolysed soy trial and has stuck closely to the diet, apart from at least 4 off-list chicken treats.
Itching has improved, falling from 5 entries a week to 0 in the last week, on 16 of 43 logged days.
The owner's flare after the chicken on Sunday suggests a chicken allergy worth confirming at the recheck.
He remains on Apoquel 16 mg once daily.
